limits: Executes the shell emitted by the supplied stdlib enrolment module with owned git/curl metadata stubs. The verdict is whether an unsafe proceed was refused, not whether a PR is bad: a runtime UNKNOWN is a refusal here. Covers moving/short pins, exact resolved SHA, fetch/bootstrap failure, missing same-repo receipt, positive fork evidence and API errors. No live network, actual provider interpolation or complete trusted checker/ancestry coverage is claimed; unit integration tests separately cover those seams. The constructed unenforced anchor allows every input, preserving the valid receipt and known-fork cases while missing every refusal. Also refuses conflicting trusted-checker verdicts rather than selecting a convenient green line.

anchors.why: Models an absent enrolment boundary: all changes proceed under a warning, with no pin, bootstrap or receipt verification.
anchors.origin: constructed unenforced bootstrap that lets all inputs proceed
